title: Transactions & Isolation Levels
interviewAnswer: Isolation levels trade concurrency against anomalies such as dirty reads, non-repeatable reads and phantoms. Serializable provides the strongest familiar abstraction but may cost throughput/retries.
keyPoints: MVCC is a common implementation technique.

why: Transactions & Isolation Levels is a recurring foundation across data science and machine learning because it affects both theoretical correctness and practical system behavior.
deepDive: Isolation levels trade concurrency against anomalies such as dirty reads, non-repeatable reads and phantoms. Serializable provides the strongest familiar abstraction but may cost throughput/retries. MVCC is a common implementation technique. Application invariants may require stronger handling than default isolation. The interview-level skill is not merely recalling the definition: explain the assumptions, what diagnostic evidence you would inspect, and what alternative you would choose when those assumptions fail.
workedExample: Two concurrent inventory reservations can oversell stock if reads/writes are not coordinated correctly.
commonMistakes: Using the concept mechanically without checking assumptions or data semantics.
